Alan-

On Friday, December 28, 2012 1:10:43 AM UTC-5, Yihui Xie wrote:
It has nothing to do with formatR, because it does not work even with
tidy=FALSE. I do not know the real reason either, but you can
certainly use cat(..., sep = '') (the default value of sep is a
space), e.g.

cat("Percent simulation error based on actual answer 244/495 is ",
      Error, "%.", "\n", sep = "")


Regards,
Yihui

On Sun, Dec 23, 2012 at 4:27 PM, Alan <arnh...@appstate.edu> wrote:
> \documentclass{article}
> \usepackage[margin=1in]{geometry}
>
> \begin{document}
>
> Problem is when I use
> \begin{verbatim}
> cat("Percent simulation error based on actual answer 244/495 is",
>       Error,"\b%.", "\n")
> \end{verbatim}
> in the code below a strange character is inserted (presumably from
> formatR?)...In the code below, I avoid the problem by running:
> \begin{verbatim}
> cat("Percent simulation error based on actual answer 244/495 is",
>       Error,"%.", "\n")
> \end{verbatim}
> But, this of course has a space between the number and the percent symbol.
> Any suggestions or workarounds much appreciated. Alan
>
> <<c01SIMcraps, comment = NA>>=
> SIMcraps <- function(n.games = 10000){
>   options(scipen=999)  # Suppress scientific notation in the output
>   # linebet returns 0 or 1 based on whether 'shooter' loses or wins
>   linebet <- function(){
>     comeoutroll <- sum(sample(1:6, 2, replace = TRUE))  # first throw
>     if (comeoutroll %in% c(7, 11)){
>       result <- 1 # win
>     } else if (comeoutroll %in% c(2, 3, 12)) {
>       result <- 0 # loss
>     } else {
>       breakvalue <- 0
>       repeat{
>         substhrow <- sum(sample(1:6, 2, replace = TRUE))
>         # subsequent throw
>         if(substhrow == comeoutroll){
>           result <- 1 # win
>           breakvalue <- 1
>         } else if (substhrow == 7){
>           result <- 0 # loss
>           breakvalue <- 1
>         }
>         if(breakvalue == 1) break
>       }
>     }
>     result
>   }
>   gameOutcome <- numeric(n.games)  # vector of 0s of length n.games
>   # Play n.games simulated crap games
>   for(i in 1:n.games){gameOutcome[i] <- linebet()}
>   # gameOutcomes is a vector of wins and losses
>   P.win <- mean(gameOutcome)       # Percent of time shooter wins
>   Actual.answer <- 244/495
>   Error <- round(abs(Actual.answer - P.win)/Actual.answer * 100, 4)
>   cat("Simulated probability of winning =",  P.win, "based on",
>       n.games, "simulated games.", "\n")
>   cat("Percent simulation error based on actual answer 244/495 is",
>       Error,"%.", "\n")
> }
> @
>
> Running the function:
>
> <<c01Simcraps2, comment = NA>>=
> SIMcraps(n.games = 50000)
> @
>
>
>
>
> \end{document}
